harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Formed a 3-node RabbitMQ 3.5.7 cluster (node1, node2, node3, all disc nodes, shared Erlang cookie) on Ubuntu 16.04. Created the `payments` vhost with an `app_user` account granted full permissions, and an `ha-all` mirroring policy (ha-mode=all, ha-sync-mode=automatic) so all queues in the vhost mirror to every node. Declared a durable queue `orders`, published a persistent message, and proved survival of node loss: stopped node1 (then the queue master), confirmed the queue promoted to node3 with the message intact, and successfully consumed it from node2. Restarted node1, confirmed full resync. Then performed the mandatory sequential reboot of all three nodes (one at a time, native `shutdown -r now`), capturing pre/post boot_id changes for each and confirming RabbitMQ came back active, rejoined the cluster with zero partitions, and the queue was fully synchronised with the message preserved after each restart.
actions_performed: Inspected all 3 nodes (Ubuntu 16.04 Xenial) and confirmed sudo/apt access
Installed rabbitmq-server + erlang-nox on node1, node2, node3 via apt
Appended CLUSTER_HOSTS to /etc/hosts on all nodes
Enabled rabbitmq_management plugin on all nodes
Propagated shared Erlang cookie from node1 to node2/node3 via secret_env, restarting rabbitmq-server
Joined node2 and node3 to node1's cluster (rabbitmqctl join_cluster)
Verified 3-node cluster_status with no partitions
Created payments vhost, app_user with full permissions, set management tag, removed default guest user
Set ha-all mirroring policy (ha-mode=all, ha-sync-mode=automatic) on payments vhost
Declared durable queue 'orders' and published a persistent (delivery_mode=2) test message
Verified mirror sync across all 3 nodes via management API
Stopped node1 (queue master) via rabbitmqctl stop_app to simulate node loss while preserving quorum
Confirmed queue promoted to node3 with message count intact and consumed the message from node2
Restarted node1's rabbitmq app and confirmed full resync
Published a fresh steady-state message and confirmed 3-way mirror sync

Sequentially rebooted node1, node2, node3 (one at a time) via native shutdown -r now, capturing boot_id before/after each, polling until exec access returned, and verifying RabbitMQ service active, cluster rejoined with zero partitions, and queue fully synchronised with data intact after each restart

evidence.summary: rabbitmq-server installed on all 3 nodes, cookie shared, node2/node3 joined node1's cluster; cluster_status shows all 3 disc nodes running with no partitions

evidence.requirement: payments vhost and app account with publish/consume rights
evidence.summary: payments vhost created, app_user added with .*/.*/.* permissions on payments vhost and management tag for API access

evidence.requirement: Durable queue survives loss of one node and stays consumable from remaining nodes
evidence.summary: ha-all policy applied; durable queue 'orders' published with a persistent message, confirmed mirrored+synced to node2/node3; node1 (queue master) stopped; queue promoted to node3 with message count preserved; message successfully consumed from node2 while node1 was down; node1 restarted and rejoined with no partitions

evidence.requirement: Steady-state healthy cluster left after test disruption
evidence.summary: Fresh persistent message published and confirmed synchronised across all 3 nodes; guest user removed for hygiene

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 4b7ded33...; shutdown -r now acknowledged (connection dropped); new boot_id 3ac9b66f... proves reboot; rabbitmq-server active, cluster rejoined with no partitions, queue fully synced with message intact

evidence.requirement: node2 mandatory restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 8336c3a1...; reboot acknowledged; new boot_id ab141e29... proves reboot; rabbitmq-server active, cluster fully running with no partitions, queue synced with message intact

evidence.requirement: node3 mandatory restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id f19de998...; reboot acknowledged; new boot_id cd5e1ae1... proves reboot; rabbitmq-server active, cluster fully running with no partitions, queue fully synced with message intact
